# Rkkp Afdk

This wiki is a comprehensive knowledge base built from the annual reports of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) and the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP). It maps the complete ecosystem of atrial fibrillation care and quality assurance in Denmark, tracking clinical quality indicators, patient outcomes, pharmacovigilance, and the underlying data infrastructure. Every factual claim, entity, and comparative analysis is directly traceable to the original source documents, providing a transparent and rigorously cited view of national cardiovascular healthcare performance.
